topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Progression
topics.groupedBecause: This opening section sets the lecture learning outcomes and outlines the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Signaling Cascades in Growth Stimulation and Survival
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell surface receptors and downstream intracellular cascades enable cells to sustain proliferative signaling and ignore growth inhibition.

topics.label: Block to Differentiation in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how failure to exit the cell cycle and complete terminal differentiation contributes to neoplastic growth in hematologic and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how malignant cells shift the balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic factors through p53 pathway disruptions to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how cancer cells maintain telomeres and overcome p53-mediated stress and senescence checkpoints to achieve indefinite division.

topics.label: Metabolic Rewiring and Oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze how tumor cells alter cellular energetics via aerobic glycolysis and generate oncometabolites that drive epigenetic modifications.

topics.label: Induction of Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the necessity, timing, and molecular equilibrium of blood vessel formation required to sustain expanding tumor tissues.

topics.label: Metastasis and Systemic Dissemination
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the multi-step physiological pathway, clonal genetics, and clinical tracking of tumor cell invasion and distant colonization.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This closing section summarises the combined impact of cancer hallmarks and concludes the lecture.
